name: controlloop
description: Review what a change lets your AI agents do, and what it installs and runs on clone, open and commit. Runs the open-source ControlLoop CLI locally against the default branch and explains its verdict, the authority each change grants, and each finding with its documentation link. Covers agent configuration and the files that install tools on clone, open and commit: dev containers, pre-commit hooks and editor startup files. Read-only; no hooks.

interface.shortDescription: Review what a change lets your agents do and installs
interface.longDescription: Ask Codex what a branch lets your AI agents do. ControlLoop runs the open-source ControlLoop CLI on your machine against the default branch and explains its verdict, the authority each change adds (MCP servers, auto-approvals, hooks, sandbox and approval settings, agent workflows, and the dev container extensions and commands, pre-commit hooks and editor startup files that install and run on clone, open and commit), and each finding with a link to its rule documentation. It is read-only: it never edits your configuration and installs nothing without asking.
capabilities: Review what a clone installs and runs
defaultPrompt: What does this branch let my agents do?
Did this change give any agent new permissions?
Explain the ControlLoop findings on this branch.
